# Copilot Session Notes

## Session Overview

This project was developed as a personal portfolio website using Express.js and Handlebars. The development process focused on creating a clean project structure, adding routes, building Handlebars views, styling the pages, and preparing the project for deployment.

## Development Steps

### Step 1: Project Setup

The project was created using the Express Generator with the Handlebars view engine.

Command used:

```bash
npx express-generator --view=hbs 

## Step 2: Routing and Views

Routes were added for the following pages:

Home
About Me
Projects
Contact Me

All routes were placed inside routes/index.js.

## Step 3: Layout and Navigation

The layout.hbs file was updated to include:

Page title
CSS stylesheet link
Header
Navigation menu
Main content area
Footer
## Step 4: Styling

The stylesheet was updated to create a professional layout with:

Dark navigation bar
Hero section
Profile image styling
Skills grid
Project cards
Contact card
Responsive layout
